content_of_post_to_comment:
I 30 (f) stoped doomscrolling in the morning, especially fist thing when I wake up. Usually, I would wake up and use my phone to stay awake. Due to time wasting and feeling harder to get motivated and start project outside of mindless scrolling I decided to do a digital detox, but especially to just stop scrolling in the morning alltogether.

Now this is where the issue is, even though I've done the digital detox successfully, now that I can feel my feelings in the morning I'm actually really annoyed and angry for no reason. My life is fine, I'm not stressed or anything, I do suffer from generalised anxiety, but I just want to see if anyone has had this issue.

TLDR: Stoped scrolling in the morning and realised I'm angry and annoyed for no reason
comment: I had a similar reaction when I cut out constant background noise. Sometimes scrolling isn't just entertainment, it's a way of avoiding the first wave of thoughts and emotions after waking up. The anger might not mean something is wrong; it could just be feelings you were numbing before. Have you noticed if it fades after being awake for a while?
